take: Per the Bruins' announcement, Boston recalled LW Michael Eyssimont from Providence (AHL) and placed LW James Hagens on injured reserve. Hagens has 12 points in 17 games, and his goal total (6) sits 2.1 above what the quality of his chances would predict, so some of that scoring may cool off. He is a second-line forward who plays 13:59 a night and works the second power-play unit. Going by how the coach has used his players, Elias Lindholm (18:08 a night) is next in line for those minutes.
